nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3 OrbitQuant
widgets_values:
MINIMAX H3 — ORBITQUANT W4A4

This workflow follows ComfyUI's bundled
MiniMax H3 Text to Video preset.

Layout:
- model and usage notes on the left
- compact generation in the center
- core Save Video on the right

Official preset:
Comfy-Org/workflow_templates
video_minimax_h3_t2v.json

KEY INPUTS

prompt
Describe the shot, camera motion, dialogue,
sound effects, and music in one block.

task
t2va for text-to-video. Use ref2va plus a
local reference_path for reference-to-video.

width / height
Verified at 608 × 480.

num_frames
124 frames: the shortest verified
five-second H3 packing sequence.

steps
50 sigma points / 49 denoiser forwards.

OFFLOAD AND PRECISION

The text encoder enters GPU for conditioning
and returns to CPU afterward.

T2VA uses manual stage offload. Ref2VA uses
H3 ComponentsManager for source FP32 VAE
reference encoding. Visual and audio decode
use untouched source FP32 VAEs.

nodes.title: Generate Video (Verified 608 × 480)
widgets_values: Single continuous live-action shot of a young woman running toward the camera in rain. The camera rapidly dollies backward, then smoothly pushes into a tight close-up while she turns her head and says in Russian: «Я здесь». Stable face identity, natural eyes and lips, coherent wet hair and jacket texture, strong motion, no cuts.

nodes.title: Note: Verified Profile
widgets_values:
VERIFIED 480P PROFILE

width                 608
height                480
frames                124
fps                    24
sigma points           50
denoiser forwards      49
visual VAE     source FP32
audio VAE      source FP32

H3 accepts 5–15 seconds. The runner rejects
shorter frame counts before allocating the
denoiser, preventing expensive invalid jobs.

Scheduler checkpoints, the latent bundle,
metrics, and stage logs are persisted as soon
as each artifact exists.
